derek: Heads up — after today's runtime merge (PR 8342) we're seeing a regression in hosted decode latency for long-context requests. Canary shows ~30% slower tail P95 on 8k tokens. Rolling back canary is on hold until we triage :warning:
ci-bot: perf-ci/job/serve-latency #462 failed: decode_p95 increase (control=120ms -> current=157ms) -- attaching flamegraph artifact: https://ci.example/462/artifacts/flamegraph.svg
jia: looking now. Initial perf profile points at attention kernel selection fallback — new heuristic picks a generic fused attention for some QKV shapes instead of the optimized split-kernel.
maria: this matches what I saw locally — when batch sizes vary we hit the less-optimal path and it forces extra memcpy of KV cache between GPU buffers. Patch in PR 8339 changed kernel selection priority (commit 9f3a2b) — suspect culprit.
derek: can we get a quick perf bisect across those commits? If it's 9f3a2b we should hotfix revert or tweak heuristic ASAP. Canary is blocking rollout for the rest of today.
alex: started a narrow bisect: running perf-runner across commits 9f3a2b..b12c8f on a 4-node rig. Early results: when selection chooses fused_attention_v2 we see +25% token-ms and a 2x increase in device->device memcopy.
sophia: posted a small repro harness in /tmp/attention_repro.py — it reproduces on A100 with sequence=8192, batch variability 1-8. Repro command:
```
python attention_repro.py --model small --seq 8192 --batch-variation 1-8 --warmup 20 --iter 200
```
Output snippet:
```
[PROFILE] kernel fused_attention_v2  52.3ms  (+30%)
[PROFILE] kernel split_attention_opt  18.7ms
[PROFILE] kv_memcopy            12.4ms  (2x)
```
derek: good repro — thanks. Next steps: 1) confirm kernel selection logic regression 2) try patched heuristic that prefers split_attention_opt for shapes where kv_memcopy > threshold 3) if patch can't land before EOD, revert commit 9f3a2b and re-run canary.
jia: I tried a local patch to selection.py to bias towards split when (seq >= 4096 and batch_variability > 1). Quick run shows decode_p95 back to baseline, token throughput restored. Will push PR 8348 for review.
maria: watch out for quantized model shapes — selection fallback was originally added to cover a pathological case for 2-bit quantization. Need a regression test that covers both. I'll add an integration test that runs the harness matrix for quantized and fp16.
ops-bot: Incident #IR-2026-03-18 opened (serving-decode-regression). Assigned: eng-runtime oncall. Priority: high.
derek: @jia @maria please coordinate on the patch vs revert. If we revert, make sure we include a postmortem entry and a precise test for the case that motivated the original change. Also hold the large rollout until we confirm canary is green. :thumbsup: 
alex: adding perf traces to PR 8348. If reviewers can't approve in 2 hours I'll prepare the revert PR 8350.
ci-bot: perf-ci/job/serve-latency #463 triggered for 8348: running benchmark matrix (quantized=true,false)
sophia: will keep the repro harness running in the background and blast different batch distributions. Ping me if you want me to run any variants.
derek: thanks team — let's aim to have either a tested heuristic or a revert before the end of the day. Keep this thread updated with short notes. :eyes:
